narrative.incident_description: The asset PWR-FW-01 (hostname nrldc-edge-fw01, IP 203.0.113.10) in the power sector is confirmed affected by CVE-2024-21762 (Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability). No evidence of exploitation has been observed.
recommended_next_actions: Verify the scope by confirming which assets are truly affected and whether the exposure is real.
Preserve relevant logs; CERT-In Directions require ICT system logs to be retained for 180 days.
Apply the vendor patch or mitigation, or otherwise restrict exposure until the patch is applied.
Conduct a hunt for signs of exploitation; if exploitation is found, reassess reportability, noting that the 6-hour reporting clock starts when the incident is noticed.
